about_the_game:
Ready Set Rumble!

Have a blast with friends and family alike in chaotic survival battles!
​Sonic Rumble is the first multiplayer party game in the iconic game series, with up to 32 players battling it out!
Who will be the world’s top Rumbler?!

■■ Explore a world full of charming stages and exciting game modes! ■■

Experience a vast array of stages with different themes and ways to play!
Rumble is packed with different gameplay styles, including Run, where players race for the top spot, Survival, where players compete to stay in the game, Ring Battle, where players duke and dodge it out for the most rings, and lots more! Matches are short, so anyone can pick it up and play in their spare time.

■■ Play with friends and family alike! ■■

Form a squad of 4 players and work together to take on other squads around the world!

■■ All your favorite Sonic characters are here! ■■

Play as Sonic, Tails, Knuckles, Amy, Shadow, Dr. Eggman, and other Sonic-series favorites!
Customize your characters to your heart’s content with a variety of character skins, animations, effects, and more!

■■ Game Setting ■■

Players control a character from the Sonic series as they enter a toy world created by the villainous Dr. Eggman, making their way through treacherous obstacle courses and dangerous arenas!

■■ Loads of music brings the world of Sonic Rumble to life! ■■

Sonic Rumble features sprightly audio for those with a need for speed!
Keep an ear out for iconic tunes from the Sonic series as well!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Pentium G3260 / AMD A8-7650K
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvdia GeForce GT 630 (VRAM 2GB) / Radeon R7 240
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 7 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100 / Ryzen 3 3100
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1050 / Radeon RX 460
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 7 GB available space
